question: How much can I hold in savings and still qualify?
context: To be eligible for housing support you must be a current resident of the borough and have a household income below the published threshold. Applicants may hold savings of up to £16,000 and still qualify for the programme. The support office is open Monday to Friday, from 9am to 5pm, at the Civic Centre. Advice sessions with a case worker last 45 minutes and can be booked by phone. For general enquiries contact the programme team at enquiries@example.org.
